releases.name: v0.20.1 — Send AGY notes on quit
releases.body:
- In AGY reviews, press `q` to send pending notes and close, just as in OpenCode. With no notes, `q` just closes. `Ctrl+C` still closes without sending.
- A successful `/annotate` interception adds a status line to clear AGY’s stuck `Working…` indicator without starting a model turn.
- Model-invoked reviews open beside an unfocused AGY pane without stealing focus. Declined slash interceptions and popup outcomes are recorded in `~/.local/share/opencode-annotate/agy-review.log`.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

See the [AGY and Herdr setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.20.1/README.md#antigravity-agy-support) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.20.0...v0.20.1).

releases.name: v0.20.0 — AGY reviews in Herdr
releases.body:
- In a configured Herdr AGY pane, `/annotate` and `prefix+a` open the native reviewer without starting a model turn. **Send** returns notes to the originating conversation; `q` and `Ctrl+C` do not send.
- Configured Kitty toolbar images render at full size in Herdr.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

See the [AGY and Herdr setup](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/blob/v0.20.0/README.md#antigravity-agy-support) and the [full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.19.0...v0.20.0).

releases.name: v0.19.0 — Annotate files
releases.body:
- Choose **Annotate a file (TUI)** or run `/annotate-file [query]` to find text and config files in the current session's directory using OpenCode's `@` file search.
- You can also pass a supported file path directly to `/annotate`. Non-Markdown files display as code blocks to preserve formatting. `.env` and credential-looking filenames are excluded.
- Browser protocol remains 10.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate/compare/v0.18.0...v0.19.0)

releases.name: v0.18.0 — Select page areas
releases.body:
- Choose **Select area** in the browser panel, then drag a rectangle around the part of the page you want to annotate. Feedback includes coordinates, visible text and element selectors when available. No screenshot is captured.
- Unsent areas keep their numbered outlines when you scroll, reload or return to the page. Select a marker to move or resize it; its evidence updates without changing its note number.
- Browser protocol 10 requires matching companion files. Reload the Chrome extension and restart OpenCode after updating.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

releases.name: v0.17.1 — picking inside modal drawers
releases.body:
- Keep annotation highlights, numbered markers and reveal outlines visible over modal drawers, including nested dialogs and same-origin frames. Page clicks still pass through the overlay.
- Match Herdr 0.9.5 pane placements. The launcher defaults to `overlay` and also supports `split`, `tab` and `zoomed`. Replace old `popup` placement and remove `popup_width` / `popup_height` settings.
- Saved notes and browser protocol 8 are unchanged. Reload the Chrome extension and refresh pages already using annotation tools after updating.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
# Already installed:
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```
